productGroup.productDescripton:
The FAB 1 Sqmm Single Core Red FR PVC CCS Copper Insulated House Wire is a high-quality low tension cable designed for residential use. With a length of 91 meters, this cable is suitable for various electrical wiring applications. The current rating of 11 Amp ensures safe and reliable transmission of electricity.

The wire is insulated with FR PVC to provide excellent fire resistance, making it a safe choice for your home. Please note that the images provided are for reference purposes only.

The conductor material used in this cable is CCS copper, known for its superior conductivity and durability. The nominal size of 1 Sqmm ensures optimal performance and efficient power transmission.

Additionally, this product comes with a warranty that covers defects in materials or workmanship that may affect the performance or reliability of the copper wire. This includes manufacturing flaws, faulty insulation, or defects in the conductive copper itself.

Choose the FAB 1 Sqmm Single Core Red FR PVC CCS Copper Insulated House Wire for a reliable and safe electrical solution for your home. Trust the brand name FAB, known for its quality products.
